title: 1.5 Infinite Limits; Limits at Infinity; Asymptotes

icans: I can find infinite limits and vertical asymptotes.
I can find limits at infinity of rational functions.
I can find the horizontal and vertical asymptotes of a rational function.

vocab: f(x) → ∞ (or −∞) as x → c: f(x) __________ without bound

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Vertical asymptote: if f(x) → ±∞ as x → c⁻ or c⁺, the line x = c is a _______________ asymptote.

blocks.stem: Find the limit of 5/(x² − 4) as x → 2⁺ and as x → 2⁻.

notes: Limits at infinity: 1/xᵖ → _______________ as x → ±∞, for p > 0.
Rational functions at infinity: divide the numerator and the denominator by the highest power of x in the _______________.

blocks.stem:
Find each limit as x → ∞.
a.  (2x + 4)/(5x)
b.  (x³ + x² + 2x − 1)/(x³ + x + 1)

notes: Horizontal asymptote: y = L is a horizontal asymptote if f(x) → L as x → ∞ or as x → _______________.

blocks.stem:
(AP® Practice) The limit as x → ∞ of (3 − 2x²)/(5x² + x) is
(A) −2/5   (B) 0   (C) 3/5   (D) ∞

tickets.stem: Find the limit as x → 3⁺ of 1/(x − 3).
Find the limit as x → ∞ of 4x²/(2x² + 1).
